linh_runtime: quick heads-up — since the last runtime deploy p99 host-side CPU for small requests jumped ~12% on prod :thinking_face:
linh_runtime: seems concentrated in the ingress/parsing path and grpc mini-write handling
perf-bot: perf-alert: p99_host_cpu increased 12% (rolling 1h). trace: https://perf.redwood.local/trace/8245
kyle_infra: do we have a flamegraph or perf trace? can we narrow to tokenize vs parse vs writev?
dave_perf: I grabbed a few perf traces from the canary hosts. main hotspot is `parse_tokenize()` and `grpc_writev_small()` back-to-back with repeated copy/mallocs. flame graph: attached in perf dashboard
sara_sre: saw errors around stream stall on 3 nodes, logs had repeated EAGAIN on write() shortly before the CPU spike
linh_runtime: minimal repro locally: send 8 concurrent 1-8 token requests to host-proxy. p99 jumps. Patch idea: avoid extra copy in ingress by moving to zero-copy buffer slice for proto unpack.
maria_prod: any quick mitigation we can roll? canary rollback?
dave_perf: quick patch I tried: replace `std::string tmp = unpack();` -> `BufferView view = unpack_view();` drops p99 ~7% in bench. microcopy below:
```
- auto tmp = unpack(); // alloc+copy
+ auto view = unpack_view(); // no alloc
  parse_view(view);
```
kyle_infra: nice. what's the risk? memory lifetime/copy semantics?
dave_perf: it's small — ensure `unpack_view()` references pooled ringbuffer not freed until request completes. added refcount in pool. stress ran 30m without leak
linh_runtime: another angle: grpc small-write pattern: we call Write() for each chunk (12-80b). try coalescing writes into a temporary iovec then one writev per message. reduces syscalls and Nagle issues for http2 framing
sara_sre: does that interact with streaming semantics? some clients rely on chunked partial data.
dave_perf: we maintain stream-by-stream ordering, coalescing only contiguous small frames within the same event loop tick. should be safe for streaming use-cases; we can add a knob.
maria_prod: can we run an A/B canary with both patches? (zero-copy + coalesce)\linh_runtime: yes — plan: add smallwrite coalesce feature gate + zero-copy unpack. A/B on 5% traffic green->ramp if no regressions
dave_perf: running microbench nightly now. initial numbers: p50 unchanged, p95 -3%, p99 -10% on small requests. also KV cache lookup tail unchanged — ruling out KV cache as primary cause
kyle_infra: I'll wire canary rollout. deploy-bot: canary deployment started for service=host-proxy, config=miniwrite-coalesce+unpack-view, traffic=5%
perf-bot: perf-bench scheduled: 8245009901 - microbench suite against canary (8c x 1-8 token workload)
sara_sre: I'll monitor streams and EAGAIN logs; any alert thresholds we should set?
maria_prod: flag me on p99_cpu > 5% or stream-stall rate > 0.5%
dave_perf: note — still seeing small allocation spikes in proto parser path when we deserialize attachments. follow-up: inline small-deserialize to avoid allocator. filing issue #PR-1245
linh_runtime: thanks all — timeline: canary now, bench results in ~10m, if green we'll roll to 25% then 100%. keep chatter here and paste traces. :thumbsup:
